ValidationRule.description: Stage gate: Advice delivery, Completed and later stages need Applications submitted and Completion date.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND(CASE(Stage__c, "Fact find", 1, "Analysis", 2, "Report drafted", 3, "Report issued", 4, "Accepted", 5, "Completed", 6, 0) >= 6, OR(NOT(Applications_submitted__c), ISBLANK(Completion_date__c)))
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Fill in Applications submitted and Completion date before moving to Completed.
